newsitem.title: ITALY: IBCA gives Banca Carige short-term A1 rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA gives Banca Carige short-term A1 rating.

text.p: European rating agency IBCA said it has assigned Italy's Banca Carige a short term rating of A1, a long-term of A, Individual of C and a legal rating of 4.
IBCA said in a statement that the Genoa-based bank has strong market shares in customer funding and lending in its home province of Liguria, which allows it to obtain stable flows of income.
"However, the local economy has proved less resilient than those of neighbouring regions and, accordingly, Banca Carige's asset quality has been adversely affected," it said.
Earlier, Moody's Investors Service assigned the bank A2/P-1 deposit ratings and a C financial strength rating.
